extracted.name: Homemade Thai Green Curry Paste
extracted.description: Recipe video above. Usually, the main reason to make homemade curry paste is because you just can't get the same intense, fresh flavour in a jar. And while that holds true for green curry paste, the other very big advantage is that you can control the spiciness without compromising flavour or the signature green colour.
ingredient_lines: 4 green cayenne pepper chilis (, deseeded and chopped (Note 1))
2 lemongrass stems (, trimmed and finely chopped (about 2.5 - 3 tbsp) (Note 2))
2 tbsp chopped coriander/cilantro root and stem ((Note 5))
1/4 cup coriander / cilantro leaves (, loosely packed)
instruction_lines: Combine all ingredients except water in a powerful blender or food processor. I use my Vitamix because it makes the paste smoother.
Blend to a fine paste, scraping down the sides as you go. Add the water as required to help it blend (you may not need any as the herbs and chilis have moisture).
Use to make Thai Green Curry!
Best to use immediately. Otherwise, refrigerate for up to 2 days, or freeze for 1 month.
